snippet.title: Euro Truck Simulator 2 - Introducing Iceland
snippet.description:
We know you might have been wondering where our next steps will lead to in Euro Truck Simulator 2, and now we are ready to reveal our plans! We are very excited to announce an upcoming map expansion, as our teams have already started to work on Iceland for Euro Truck Simulator 2!

Read more on our blog 👉 https://blog.scssoft.com/2025/06/introducing-iceland.html

Add this DLC to your Steam wishlist 👉 https://store.steampowered.com/app/3796990/#game_area_purchase
